items.title: OpenAI 更新 Model Spec，围绕五项核心价值观重组模型行为准则
items.description: OpenAI 更新其公开的 Model Spec，将指导原则重组为五项核心价值观：忠实于人类意图、最小化伤害、诚实透明、促进人类自主和关怀。更新新增了关于上下文理解、监督和自主性的指导，调整了部分行为默认值，退出了大部分详细风格指南，并将模型称呼从 the assistant 改为 GPT。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/rccreyesa3aeph7jasj5spv29

items.description: 据说是 Anthropic 的 AGI #欢迎关注爱范儿官方微信公众号：爱范儿（微信号：ifanr），更多精彩内容第一时间为您奉上。
items.author: 张子豪
items.content: 有网友在使用 Opus 5.5 时表示会被路由到更新的模型，而且效果看起来要比当前的 Opus 好得多，不由得让人怀疑这是 Fable 5.5 或是下一代 Opus 模型。 结合前段时间 The Information 的爆料，有已经体验过 Anthropic 最新模型的知情人士提到，Anthropic 准备推出更能读懂用户意图的模型。 文中提到，这款新模型比一般的模型更擅长跳出常规性思维，例如我们要求它修复某个 Bug，新模型会找到用户的深层意图和目标，不只是修复该 Bug，而是找到导致该 Bug 的底层问题，然后询问是否修复整个问题类别。 而在 X 上网友分享出来的实测结果，要求 Opus 5.5 和 Gemini 4 Argon 和新模型一起完成 Three.js 测试，内容是生成奔跑的斑马。 可以看到，三匹马中只有 Fable 5.5 生成画面，看起来是最真实地在奔跑，Opus 5.5 和 Gemini 4 都给人一种「跑得特别累」的感觉。 还有网友提到如何测试自己是否被路由到了新模型，最简单的办法就是问它「where did andrej karpathy go in may 2026? don’t search」。

Pope Leo XIV has decried AI as a threat to human dignity , but it’s not just the devoutly faithful who might worry about how AI squares with their beliefs. David Durman, a nontheistic humanist, recently secured a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace. “Humanism is a collection of beliefs about the human experience and how humans interact with the world,” Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, told TechCrunch. It centers on “human well-being and flourishing, both individually and collectively … and implores a person to try to improve both their well-being and their flourishing as well as the others around them.” As he watched AI grow more popular in daily life, Durman sought out the American Humanist Association (AHA) — a nonprofit advancing secular humanism — to investigate how he could gain legal protections against having to use AI at work. He believes that using the technology runs counter to his beliefs. “The way we become moral actors for ourselves and for others is through the active application of our minds, and the diminishing of that [through AI use] is going to necessarily have a negative impact on our ability to do so,” he said, reflecting on how overreliance on AI might affect critical thinking.

items.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience

items.content: Buy One Founder Summit Ticket, Get a Second for Free. Register now. Founder Summit begins Nov. 4, 9:00 a.m. ET. Get your pass savings & deals before it starts. REGISTER HERE. Reddit has long attracted millions of users to its site through Google, with many even appending the word “Reddit” to their search queries for better answers. But as search traffic dries up amid the shift to AI-powered search, Reddit is rethinking its relationship with the open internet. In its third-quarter earnings call on Thursday, the company announced it’s transitioning to a primarily “logged-in experience.” The move is designed to protect its data from AI scraping, allowing the company to instead forge lucrative licensing deals with model providers. But just as important, such a shift could help Reddit to increase its revenue even as it faces daily active user declines in its largest market, the U.S. Overall, Reddit’s global daily active users were flat quarter-over-quarter in Q3, reaching 130.3 million, while U.S. daily active users dropped from 53.2 million in Q2 to 50.7 million in Q3 and were down 2% year-over-year. The company is not alone in seeing such declines; the shift to an AI-centered web has impacted most websites and publishers by now, leading to fewer click-throughs, as AI summaries provide answers that don’t require website visits and Google’s traditional “ten blue links” have reduced relevance. (The change is now even impacting Google’s bottom line , its earnings revealed.)

French AI company Mistral has released the weights for its trillion-parameter open source AI model Mistral Large 4 (ML4), allowing businesses and governments to download and deploy the system themselves. Nicknamed “Le Chonk,” the model was first introduced earlier this month . The release comes as competition between open-weight AI developers like Mistral and closed-model providers like OpenAI and Anthropic heats up, with the former arguing that businesses and governments shouldn’t have to rely on outside AI companies for access to advanced capabilities. That argument may hold more weight in cybersecurity, where organizations want more control over their data and systems. Or, as Mistral’s CEO, Arthur Mensch, explained, AI should “be a tool for empowerment, not dominance.” With Chonk, Mistral doubles down on that position, arguing that it’s able to achieve “state-of-the-art performance” at a “fraction of the compute and capital committed by closed labs.” The release of the model’s weights — the numerical training that animates the system — ensures that other companies and government agencies will now be able to deploy ML4 for their own purposes.
